scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/wheel --pretty false && tsc -p packages/chalk --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/demos --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/docs --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/playground --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/tracker --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/rounds --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/website --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p cloudflare --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.test: bun run test:unit:components && bun run test:unit:node
scripts.row-schema: bun run row-schema:wire && bun run row-schema:tracker && bun run row-schema:rounds && bun run row-schema:demos && bun run row-schema:docs

scripts.row-schema:rounds:check: bun scripts/generate-row-fingerprints.ts packages/rounds/server/modules.ts ROUNDS_SCHEMA_SPEC_INPUT packages/rounds/row-schema.generated.ts --check && bun scripts/generate-row-fingerprints.ts packages/rounds/browser/upgrade/rounds-b.server.ts ROUNDS_B_SCHEMA_SPEC_INPUT packages/rounds/browser/upgrade/row-schema-b.generated.ts --check
scripts.check:static: bun run lint && bun scripts/behavior-coverage.ts --check && bun run schema:wire:check && bun run schema:tracker:check && bun run schema:rounds:check && bun run row-schema:check && bun run seed:tracker:check && bun run docs:robots:check && bun run typecheck && bun run check:tracker-services && bun run check:wrangler-types && bun run test:package
scripts.check:unit:js: bun run test && bun run test:docs && bun run test:backends && bun run test:wire
scripts.check:unit: bun run check:unit:js && bun run test:elixir

scripts.test:browser:tracker:postgres: WHEEL_BROWSER_DEV_MODE=1 bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && TRACKER_BROWSER_BACKEND=postgres playwright test --config packages/tracker/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:tracker:do: WHEEL_BROWSER_DEV_MODE=1 bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && TRACKER_BROWSER_BACKEND=do playwright test --config packages/tracker/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:tracker:all: bun run test:browser:tracker:sqlite && bun run test:browser:tracker:postgres && bun run test:browser:tracker:do
scripts.test:browser:rounds: WHEEL_BROWSER_DEV_MODE=1 bun run --cwd packages/rounds build && playwright test --config packages/rounds/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:rounds:upgrade: WHEEL_BROWSER_DEV_MODE=1 ROUNDS_DIST_DIR=../../.artifacts/rounds/contract-a bun run --cwd packages/rounds build && WHEEL_BROWSER_DEV_MODE=1 ROUNDS_CONTRACT=b ROUNDS_DIST_DIR=../../.artifacts/rounds/contract-b bun run --cwd packages/rounds build && ROUNDS_UPGRADE=1 playwright test --config packages/rounds/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:components: bun run --cwd packages/playground audit:build && playwright test --config packages/playground/playwright.config.ts
scripts.dev:demos:preview: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && portless wheel-demos-preview bun run --cwd packages/demos preview
scripts.demos:embed: DEMOS_BASE=/demos/ VITE_SYNC_MODE=browser vite build --config packages/demos/vite.config.ts --outDir dist-embed
scripts.website: bun run demos:embed && bunx vite --config packages/website/vite.config.ts
scripts.website:build: bun run demos:embed && bunx vite build --config packages/website/vite.config.ts
scripts.dev:tracker:preview: bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && portless wheel-tracker-preview bun run --cwd packages/tracker preview
scripts.test:browser:demos: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && playwright test --config packages/demos/playwright.config.ts --grep-invert '@(standalone|embedded)'
scripts.test:behaviors:smoke: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && playwright test --config packages/demos/playwright.config.ts --grep '@smoke'
scripts.check:behaviors: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && playwright test --config packages/demos/playwright.config.ts --grep '@(standalone|embedded)'
